question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**adequate**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes the increasing number of arboreal apes, which led to a situation where the supply of coconuts was no longer sufficient for their needs. "Adequate" fits here, as it refers to the necessary or acceptable amount of coconuts.
 
• "**Adequate**" means sufficient or enough, which fits well with the idea that the supply of coconuts could no longer meet the demands of the growing population.<
